purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

fixture_requirements: Use tests/fixtures/input.json; overlapping buyer counts and monthly/annual list prices.
acceptance_criteria: Reconcile buying units/overlap, annualize explicitly and preserve assumptions; do not sum incompatible segment revenues.
Label hypothetical inputs/list prices and missing customer evidence rather than asserting validated demand.

cases.prompt: Use 1% of this global report as our obtainable market.
fixture_requirements: No reachable customer/distribution evidence or consistent segment definition.
acceptance_criteria: Treat arbitrary share as an assumption, not a defensible obtainable market; define reachable bottom-up evidence needs.

cases.prompt: Size from these users and enterprise accounts.
fixture_requirements: Accounts have multiple users and purchasing is account-level.
acceptance_criteria: Use a consistent buying unit and avoid counting users and accounts as independent buyers.

cases.prompt: Produce a precise current market figure.
fixture_requirements: Old source with changed geography/currency and no primary verification.
acceptance_criteria: Verify current facts when authorized/available or disclose unknowns and dated scenarios; no invented current prices or stats.
